'''Harbin-re opera''' was a type of [[Neoclassical period|Neoclassical]] [[Music/Legends|music]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Harbin-re]]. The [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was scheduled to perform selections from the opera during its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour starting in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
